$comment: DTM 2000-2011 rules, set up on 2003 (the mother template). A season patch is applied on top (tools/layers.py): 2003 uses one qualifying session (its Superpole is not possible, wishlist A5 and A6); 2006 and 2010 knockout qualifying. Two mandatory stops are not a game rule (wishlist B5): tyre wear and the refuelling tank make two stops the normal strategy.
